subject: VARYING clause
notes: kb/Work PB1305 (w70 V3) closes finding F1: every arithmetic-expression-1/-2 the format admits now compiles and runs. The VARYING counters are Int128 compose locals (§13.18.64.4 GR1 'an independent temporary integer data item that shall be large enough to contain the maximum expected value', cite OK) and VaryValue lands FROM/BY in the value's own lane (fixed point unscaled at its scale, binary64, SDIDI) through CobolReport.VaryingInteger. Golden conformance:cases/13.18.64-VARYING/pb1305_report_varying_expression: FROM 2 * 3 - 5 BY 4 - 2 -> 1 3 5; BY WS-F (PIC 9V9 = 2.0) -> 1 3 5; FROM a COMP-2 4 BY 7 - 2 * 3 -> 4 5 6 (each was a CS0266 backend crash). The grammar is faithful; the VALIDATE-leg twin stays refused by name (COBOL1708, the declined VALIDATE facility, docs/CONFORMANCE.md §5).
